pageTitle: Is Math Now Part of CS?
title: Is math now a subfield of computer science?

claim.text: “Mathematics is now a subfield of computer science.”
context: Posted after a run of AI results in math: olympiad-level proofs, formal proofs in Lean, help on some open problems.

lead: The AI results are real. The trouble is the step from that evidence to the conclusion, which only works with two premises nobody says out loud.

premises.text: P1: AI now solves hard math problems and writes proofs
premises.note: Mostly problems someone already stated: olympiads, conjectures, Lean goals.

premises.text: P2: Those AI systems come from computer science
premises.note: And they run on math: linear algebra, probability, logic.

premises.text: (hidden) If a field's tools can do its work, it belongs to the tools' field
premises.note: Telescopes didn't make astronomy part of optics.

premises.text: (hidden) Solving given problems is all of math
premises.note: Math also picks the questions and invents the concepts.

conclusion.text: ∴ Math is a subfield of CS
conclusion.note: What the evidence supports: computation is now central to how math is done.

vennLead: "Math is a subfield of CS" is a claim about containment. The AI results are evidence about the overlap.

venn.note: Math ⊂ CS: nothing in math left outside CS.
The overlap grew. Every AI result lands in it.
CS is built on math, so by the same rule CS ⊂ Math. Both can't be true.

testsLead: Say each hidden premise out loud, then try it where you already know the answer.

tests.title: Does the tool's field absorb the subject?
parallels: CS is built on logic and math
body: The last line is the same rule run backwards. An argument that proves too much proves nothing.

tests.kind: Hidden premise 2 · what the evidence covers
tests.title: Is solving problems all of math?
body: The breakthroughs are on problems someone already stated. Mathematics also decides which questions matter and invents the concepts they are written in.

steelman.title: The charitable reading
steelman.quote: Computation is becoming central to how mathematics is done.
body: That claim fits the evidence. It is about methods, and needs neither hidden premise.
